items: Isolate circuit breaker and ground it
Change remote switch to local operation position

Proper well fixed ladder should be used for climbing on the
 breaker

Complete toolset, rag and air blower, Dew point, acidity equipment
 and contact resistance equipment
Check the door gasket of control cabinet

Clean panel by blower, Bushings and connectors for dust and
 dirt

Check control wiring for loose connections and tighten all
 connections as required.
Check the operation mechanism of the CB for loose bolts.

Check gas dew point according to MPIS document no.
 TD-SS-004-r0
Measure break and carryout the timing test for CB using time equipment.

Measure contact resistance according to MPIS doc.
 no.CB-004-r0
Check acidity contact of SF6 gas (MPIS doc no. TD-SS-004-r0)
Check the pressure of SF6, ref. value 7 : 6.3 atm

text:
Substations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
Safety Precautions
Isolate circuit breaker and ground it
Isolate the DC voltage
Change remote switch to local operation position
Proper well fixed ladder should be used for climbing on the
 breaker
Tools and Equipment
Complete toolset, rag and air blower, Dew point, acidity equipment
 and contact resistance equipment
Works to be Carried Out
Check the door gasket of control cabinet
Clean panel by blower, Bushings and connectors for dust and
 dirt
Check control wiring for loose connections and tighten all
 connections as required.
Check the gas leak
Check the operation mechanism of the CB for loose bolts.
Check gas dew point according to MPIS document no.
 TD-SS-004-r0
Measure break and carryout the timing test for CB using time equipment.
Measure contact resistance according to MPIS doc.
 no.CB-004-r0
Check acidity contact of SF6 gas (MPIS doc no. TD-SS-004-r0)
Check the pressure of SF6, ref. value 7 : 6.3 atm
